concepts.gloss_en: The serpent (primordial snake as mystical archetype of evil/servitude/enticement)

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are vocalized נָחָשׁ/הַנָּחָשׁ and every one is used as בחינת הנחש — the serpent as the archetype of evil (Canaan slave-of-slaves, the cursed one, the tannina that entices selfish prayer, the 'wise to do evil'). The presence/absence of the definite article here is purely grammatical (בחינת נחש vs בחינת הנחש both denote the same archetypal serpent, not a generic-vs-archetype split), so they merge cleanly.
